findings.message: Track 0 has 9 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: <div id="shot-0"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="shot-0"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
